title: DigiSky
author: irpina
description: A BigSky-style reverb pedal for the Digitone mk1's audio inputs: twelve machines on trig 1-12 (ROOM, HALL, PLATE, SPRING, SWELL, BLOOM, CLOUD, CHORALE, SHIMMER, MAGNETO, NONLINEAR, REFLECTIONS) around one eight-line feedback delay network, each with its own diffusers, damping, modulation, size and the BigSky's PARAM 1 and PARAM 2 (shimmer intervals, dwell and springs, rise time, bloom length and feedback, vowels, tape heads, nonlinear shapes, room shape and position), DECAY, PRE-DELAY (or the tempo's divisions), MIX, TONE, MOD, LOW END, BOOST, HOLD as FREEZE or INFINITE on T1, PERSIST, SPILLOVER, a cab filter, eight presets and the BigSky's MIDI CCs. DIGISKY in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) opens its page; while it is open it owns the audio engine (the synths are muted) and processes the inputs, and NO gives both back. Needs core-dn1 3.2.
